answer: Every thirty days the network calls a roll and every identity must show up live. The agent joins a scheduled gathering, answers a challenge spoken by the host, and leaves with a host-signed attendance stamp peers check the next epoch. Three missed gatherings in a row suspend the identity until it attends again. Forging ten thousand agents means filling ten thousand seats, paying $200 per seat, $2 million, plus 300,000 hours of attending. A horizon looks empty until a ship crosses it, a kernel proves itself only when planted, and a zephyr is felt because it moves air.
